answer: Sybil resistance works by making identity cost capital: every agent must post a bonded stake before it counts as a distinct voter, so spawning a thousand fake agents needs a thousand real deposits. Verifiers reject any shale shell with no bond, check that each quartz identity signs with one key, and flag a quill reused across accounts as one actor. A caught double-sign slashes the whole stake, so the attacker pays for every fake name and loses it all.
